summary: Iteration 6 validation of the 4 new FleetIntel features (Vehicle Health Trend chart, Incident Photos Lightbox, Auto-Assign Driver on Report incident, and Health Alerts weekly digest email). Backend: appended TestVehicleHealthTrend (6 tests: default 30 entries, days clamp 7-180, 404 on unknown vehicle, trend[-1].score matches fleet-health, auth required) and TestHealthDigest (5 tests: manual send requires auth + admin returns sent+email_id, cron 401 without/wrong secret, cron 200 with correct WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET). pytest = 46/46 passing (35 existing + 11 new). Also confirmed regression on /api/analytics/fleet-health, PATCH /api/incidents/{id}, GET/PUT /api/users/me/prefs, drivers/vehicles/incidents CRUD. Frontend: admin login OK; VehicleDetail (/fleet/:id, Falcon-01) shows health-trend-card with recharts LineChart (svg=1, reference lines=2 at 80 & 55, line curve=1) and current-health-score=84; Report incident modal auto-selects the vehicle's currently-assigned driver in incident-driver select and shows the 'auto-filled from vehicle' marker; Incidents page lightbox opens on photo-thumb-<id>-0, lightbox-counter shows '1 / 2', lightbox-next advances to '2 / 2', lightbox-prev returns to '1 / 2', ArrowRight key advances to '2 / 2', Esc dismisses (lightbox-close button also dismisses).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2020 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Splitting into routers (auth, fleet, incidents, analytics, prefs, digests, cron) is still overdue and will make future changes safer.
_score_vehicle correctly parameterizes as_of so both live fleet-health and backfilled trend share deterministic scoring — trend[-1] matches fleet-health verified by test.

/cron/health-digest uses secrets.compare_digest against WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET (constant-time) and enqueues via asyncio.create_task so the endpoint acks immediately — good pattern, mirrors /cron/weekly-digest.

days clamping in /analytics/vehicle/{vid}/health-trend uses max(7, min(days, 180)) — consider raising a 400 for out-of-range input instead of silently clamping so callers can tell they were adjusted; document current behaviour otherwise.

Incidents.jsx lightbox onKeyDown is attached to the overlay div with tabIndex=0 and ref-focus; works today but `ref={(el) => el && el.focus()}` re-focuses on every render and can steal focus from inner children (image tab focus etc). Prefer a useEffect-driven focus on mount.

VehicleDetail.jsx assignedDriver preselect happens only in openIncidentModal — if drivers load AFTER the user has already opened the modal, the driver_id will remain empty. Consider syncing incForm.driver_id when assignedDriver becomes available while modal is open.
In VehicleDetail.jsx, incidents auto-refresh after submit updates timeline + healthTrend but does not refresh inspections/maint; fine but be aware for future correctness.
